[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/07/21 (Fri) 22:06  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] To create and export a report in Kibana, open Kibana and navigate to the dashboard or visualization you want to include in your report.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Click on the "Share" button in the top right corner of the screen.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Choose "Generate PDF" from the dropdown menu.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] In the "PDF Reports" dialog box, select the report format, orientation, and page size. You can also customize the report title and add a description.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Choose whether to include a cover page, a table of contents, and other optional elements in the report.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Click the "Generate" button to generate the report.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Once the report is generated, you can preview it by clicking on the "Download" button in the dialog box. You can also choose to save the report to your computer, send it via email, or print it.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The "Generate PDF" feature is available in the Kibana UI only for Kibana 7.1 and later.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For earlier versions of Kibana, you can use third-party plugins or the Reporting API to generate reports.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Kibana also supports the creation of CSV reports, which can be exported from Kibana's Discover UI.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] To create a CSV report, open Kibana and navigate to the Discover UI, run your search query, and click on the "Download" button in the top right corner.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Choose the "CSV" format from the dropdown menu, select whether to include column headers, and choose the field delimiter.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Click the "Download" button to download the report.  
[USER] How is machine learning setup?  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] To set up machine learning in Kibana, install and configure the Elastic Stack, prepare your data, configure machine learning settings, train your models, evaluate and refine your models, and deploy your models.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Elastic Stack includes Elasticsearch, Logstash, and Beats.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Data should be well-structured and organized for analysis, and you need to identify features for your machine learning models.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] In Kibana, configure settings for your machine learning models, such as algorithms, maximum anomalies to detect, and time range for training/testing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID]
